nom: TATCHA The Serum Stick Line-Smoothing Treatment & Touch Up Balm

avis.texte: Easy to use. Good hydration while keeping makeup in tact. I have been using under my eyes, above my lips, forehead...I look the dewy, fresh look. Have only been using about 2 weeks but I like it so far. Would buy again.
Bought this for my mother in law, saw improvement less than a week
Sounds stupid bc everyone basically say the same thing in good reviews but I have chronically dark circles above and below my eyes. Absolutely incredible product, results in a week stg

I use this all over my face, especially in the winter to alleviate sensitive and dry skin I have purchased this numerous times and always keep it handy. It is also convenient to use when flying because the airplane climate makes my skin feel super dry and easily passed TSA requirements

This stuff is great! I mostly use it under my eyes, lips and forehead wrinkles. If you are sick or have allergies and blow your nose a lot, this is great to use under your nose before going to bed. Wake up in the morning and the skin around your nose is back to normal! I have also used it on scars to help promote healing. Love, love, love it!

I originally purchased this product to wear with my tinted moisturizer to help with my dry skin. I don't feel that it works well with makeup but I will buy again. I use around mouth, smile lines, under and around eyes and on my forehead after cleansing and moisturizing before bed. My skin feels incredible in the morning! I hope this doesn't go away ever!
I love this product!! I use it in the morning and at night. I have noticed a improvement under and around my eyes. Its smooth and feels nice on. It never leaves me feeling greasy.
This serum stick is fantastic. It really smooths out lines, easy to apply and unscented which is great for sensitive skin. It's a soothing, gentle fix for dry spots, and a great highlighter as well.

I have very dry skin especially in the winter and i found this almost instantly relieves it. I like the formula although it is very pricey so might not purchase again. Could be greasy feeling if you apply too much

This stick is such a great way to prime and add serum at the same time. And perfect for travel. I use it all n the backs of my hands too and. Have noticed they look younger. It goes fast though, probably faster than a liquid serum would.

I use this before my concealer and it's helping with creasing. It's also perfect at the end of the day when I need a makeup touch up.

After i do my am skincare, (includes the dewy moisturizer) i apply tatchas dewy sunscreen & then use the serum stick under my eyes & around my nose where my pores are the largest, and let me tell you this is better than any makeup primer ive bought. It smooths my pores and undereyes ALL DAY LONG. Keeps my makeup looking super dewy & fresh until i take it off at night. Its pricey? But itll last ages. I recommend this to everyone who compliments my skin/makeup. Obsessed honestly.
First time I tried this we could see immediate results! It works.

I bought based on the raving reviews, and my obsession with skincare products lol more so because I have LOVED every Tatcha product I've had. That said, it is a profound game changer if you struggle with seriously dry lips, my lips suffer from drying medications, but I know some skin conditions are such a battle to control. On my face, I never felt like it sunk in, which is probably the greasy feel people got as it thinned out with warmth. No, emulsifying doesnt help either.

I bought this for reducing the appearance of fine lines, (which it states it will do ) but it did not do that for me. I found it very greasy. It might be good as a moisturizing stick but that's not what I bought it for. When I put it over my makeup, which it says you can do, it wipes my makeup away. Will be returning.
I am obsessed with this product. I use it everyday under my eyes. I will definitely be buying this product again.

avis.titre: PERFECT for very sensitive dry eyes
avis.texte: I read all of the reviews and saw it was hit or miss I do NOT wear makeup everyday so this has become my go-to for pickup on my undereye My undereye are not in need of firming but they are incredibly dry and sensitive I always wake up with almost crusty lower lash lines! So now I just apply it directly on my eyes under do a few swipes then use my fingers to cover my undereye and crows feet Sometimes I'll pull it to the top eyelid but it's mostly for the bottom If you wear makeup this obviously will not be good to apply multiple times a day This seems to be good for people with dry skin sensitivity to products and fragrance this has none and those not looking specifically for firming
